keyboardConverter.title: Keyboard Converter
keyboardConverter.description: Convert English keystrokes to Korean and vice versa. Useful when you forget to switch keyboard layout.
keyboardConverter.copyFailed: Copy failed — select and copy manually

howTo.title: How to Use
items: Type or paste text in the input area for real-time conversion
Click example buttons to see instant conversions
Use the swap button to exchange input and output

tips.title: Tips
items: Useful when you typed without switching the keyboard layout
Double consonants (ㄲ, ㄸ) correspond to Shift+key
Eng→Kor converts based on QWERTY keyboard positions to Korean
Kor→Eng decomposes Korean into jamo and maps to English keys

whatIs.title: What is the Korean-English Keyboard Converter?
whatIs.description: The Korean-English Keyboard Converter instantly converts text typed in the wrong input language. For example, if you accidentally typed Korean characters while in English mode (resulting in 'dkssud' instead of '안녕'), this tool converts it back to the correct text. It also handles the reverse — English characters typed in Korean mode.

items.q: What if the conversion isn't accurate?
items.a: Special characters, numbers, or differences between Dubeolsik and Sebeolsik keyboard layouts can cause inaccuracies. The conversion is based on the standard Dubeolsik (두벌식) layout.

items.q: Can I convert long text all at once?
items.a: Yes. Paste multiple sentences or a long paragraph and convert everything at once.

items.q: How do I copy the converted result?
items.a: Click the copy button in the result area to instantly copy the converted text to your clipboard.
